newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jardine, James Hardie unit form joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Jardine, James Hardie unit form joint venture.

text.p: Jardine Davies Inc said on Friday it has finalised the terms of a shareholders agreement for a joint venture firm with RCI Pty Ltd, a unit of James Hardie Industries Ltd.

Jardine Davies chairman Aloysius Colayco said in an advisory to the Philippine Stock Exchange that the joint venture company, Jardine James Hardie Philippines Co Inc, will engage in the manufacture of fibre cement and board products using the technology of James Hardie Group.
The shareholders agreement will be signed on Friday. Under the agreement, Jardine will hold two-thirds of the company while RCI will hold the rest.
